rows.note: Use 計劃 as the everyday all-purpose choice when “chart” means to plan out what will happen.

example.english: We need to chart out our trip for next month.
example.traditional: 我哋要計劃好下個月去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gai3 waak6 hou2 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use 規劃 instead of 計劃 when mapping out a route, layout, or broader arrangement.

example.english: This website can chart the whole route for us.
example.traditional: 呢個網站可以幫我哋規劃成條路線。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 kwai1 waak6 sing4 tiu4 lou6 sin3

rows.note: Use 畫路線 when “chart” specifically means to draw or mark out a route.

example.english: Use a pen to chart the route on the map.
example.traditional: 你用支筆喺張地圖上面畫路線啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 jung6 zi1 bat1 hai2 zoeng1 dei6 tou4 soeng6 min6 waa6 lou6 sin3 laa1

rows.note: Use 圖表 as the all-purpose noun for a visual diagram or graph, rather than a data table.

example.english: This chart is clear at a glance.
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tou4 biu2 jat1 tai2 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use 畫地圖 when “chart” literally means to draw a map.

example.english: I’ll chart a map for you so you can find your way easily.
example.traditional: 我幫你畫地圖，等你容易搵路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 waa6 dei6 tou4 dang2 nei5 jung4 ji6 wan2 lou6

rows.note: Use 病歷 for a patient's medical record, including their diagnosis, treatment, and recent history.

example.english: The doctor said I need to show my chart to the new hospital.
example.traditional: 醫生話我份病歷要畀新醫院睇。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 fan6 beng6 lik6 jiu3 bei2 san1 ji1 jyun2 tai2

rows.note: Use 表格 when the chart is a grid of rows and columns containing data.

example.english: This chart lists the income from every vehicle this month.
example.traditional: 呢張表格列晒今個月每部車嘅收入。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 biu2 gaak3 lit6 saai3 gam1 go3 jyut6 mui5 bou6 ce1 ge3 sau1 jap6

rows.note: Use 排行榜 for a ranked list such as a music chart.

example.english: This song was number one on the chart last week but dropped this week.
example.traditional: 呢首歌上個星期喺排行榜排第一，今個星期跌咗落去。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 soeng6 go3 sing1 kei4 hai2 paai4 hang4 bong2 paai4 dai6 jat1 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 dit3 zo2 lok6 heoi3
